localizedValues.description:
Posey Island is part of the Cascadia Marine Trail System. All camping at Posey Island is limited to persons traveling or arriving by non-motorized, human powered or wind powered, beachable watercraft. There is no potable water on the island, and visitors must pack out what they pack in. 

Commercial users must have a valid copy and register on site their Washington State Parks Commercial Use Permit number. A copy of the permit will also be available to be presented to the Ranger upon request.
